sentences.en: I feel completely restored after a week in the country.
sentences.zh: 我在乡下待了一周后感觉完全恢复了。

sentences.en: Peace-keeping troops moved in to restore calm after the battle.
sentences.zh: 战后的维和部队进驻以恢复秩序。

sentences.en: You can also ride on an old, restored, steam train.
sentences.zh: 你还可以乘坐一辆老式修复过的蒸汽火车行驶。

senses.zh: 恢复（某种情况或感受）,使复原,使复位,使复职
